intro: Cambodia's economy has grown fast on clothing exports, tourism and farming.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Garment and shoe factories employ hundreds of thousands. Rice, rubber and cashews are big crops, and Angkor draws millions of tourists.
US dollars are used alongside the Cambodian riel.

chapters.title: Landmines
text: Decades of war left millions of landmines; trained rats and dogs help clear them.

cardGroups.title: Made in Cambodia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Cambodia makes and sells to the world.
